meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为系统化、有据可循的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将模糊目标转化为可执行的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into systematic, evidence-bound steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn vague goals into actionable steps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“超工作模式”将复杂目标分解为系统化的、有证据约束的步骤，并持续执行直到完成。它会使用专门的 CLI 工具管理状态，并自动调用子代理处理代码编辑、测试等任务。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”、持久目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动 QA 或带检查点的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop，帮我分解并执行这个项目目标。
say.note: Claude 会读取工作流文件并开始执行。

say.text: 使用 ulw 模式，将当前任务拆解为有证据的步骤。
say.note: Claude 会进入超工作循环，逐步推进。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude decomposes complex goals into systematic, evidence-bound steps using ultrawork mode, and executes them persistently. It manages state via a CLI tool and delegates code edits, tests, etc. to subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop and help me decompose and execute this project goal.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow file and begins execution.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to break down the current task into evidence-bound steps.
say_en.note: Claude enters the ultrawork loop and proceeds step by step.
